os.makedirs(d,exist_ok=True)
src='''from collections import deque, Counter

def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; comp=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]!=bg:
                            seen[x][y]=True; q.append((x,y))
                comps.append(comp)
    seed=max(comps,key=len)
    cells={(i,j):g[i][j] for i,j in seed}
    ci=sum(i for i,j in seed)//len(seed); cj=sum(j for i,j in seed)//len(seed)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for comp in comps:
        if comp is seed or len(comp)!=1: continue
        i,j=comp[0]
        for (a,b),v in cells.items():
            x,y=a+i-ci,b+j-cj
            if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w: out[x][y]=v
    return out
'''
